verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Make's custom apps framework (app components such as connections, webhooks and modules) for building your own integrations. It shows no marketplace, registry, or install path for community-built apps contributed by third parties. Building your own app is a developer building block, not the ability to install community contributions, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor
